id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

inspection.description:
The owning {@link ThermalInspection}. Inverse of
{@link ThermalInspection#anomalies}.

anomalyIndex.description:
Zero-based order of this anomaly within its inspection, used to label markers
("#1", "#2", …) consistently between the image and the findings list.

category.description:
Short category label, e.g. 'Window-frame thermal contrast',
'Possible thermal bridging', 'Door-seal irregularity',
'Wall/ceiling temperature pattern', or 'Ambiguous thermal pattern'.

polarity.description:
Whether the region reads warmer ('hot') or cooler ('cold') than its
surroundings in the image.

xPct.description: Bounding-box left edge as a fraction (0..1) of image width.

yPct.description: Bounding-box top edge as a fraction (0..1) of image height.

wPct.description: Bounding-box width as a fraction (0..1) of image width.

hPct.description: Bounding-box height as a fraction (0..1) of image height.

relativeIntensity.description:
Signed deviation of the region from the image's mean thermal score, normalized
to roughly -1..1 (positive = hotter than average, negative = cooler).

areaPct.description: Fraction (0..1) of the total image area covered by this region.

locationLabel.description: Human-readable location within the frame, e.g. 'upper-left' or 'center'.

observation.description: What the image visually shows at this region (AI-written, descriptive only).

possibleCauses.description: Possible building-related causes for the pattern (AI-written).

alternativeExplanations.description:
Alternative, non-defect explanations that could produce a similar pattern —
reflections, emissivity differences, camera palette artifacts (AI-written).

verificationStep.description: Recommended next verification step before drawing any conclusion (AI-written).

priority.description: Qualitative priority for following up this finding: 'Low', 'Medium', or 'High'.

title:
A single candidate thermal anomaly: one suspicious region detected inside a
{@link ThermalInspection}'s image, paired with an AI-written cautious explanation.

The bounding box ({@link ThermalAnomaly#xPct} …) is derived from the actual image
pixels on the client; the prose fields ({@link ThermalAnomaly#observation} …) are
generated by {@link ThermalInspection#analyze}. A recorded anomaly is a
**screening observation to verify**, not a confirmed defect.
name: ThermalAnomaly
